name: llm-html-bench
description: Desktop benchmark database and inspection laboratory for LLM-generated HTML applications

scripts.build: npm run generate-icons && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:win: npm run generate-icons && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run generate-icons && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run generate-icons && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.test: vitest run tests/htmlExtractor.test.ts tests/scoreCalculator.test.ts && electron scripts/test-database.mjs
